newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PRESS DIGEST - HK newspaper headlines - Feb 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - HK newspaper headlines - Feb 4.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Hong Kong press on Tuesday. Reuters had not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- SOUTH CHINA MORNING POST -- British and Chinese negotiators are deadlocked over the handing over of confidential files on senior Hong Kong government officials to Beijing.
-- HONG KONG STANDARD -- China is willing to hold political talks with Taiwan in a move aimed at ending decades of hostility and lessening tensions across the Taiwan Strait.
-- A founding father of China's fledgling securities industry has been sentenced to 17 years in jail for taking bribes and embezzling public funds.
-- WEN WEI PO -- The first meeting of the post-handover government's Executive Council will be held today, chaired by Chief Executive-designate Tung Chee-hwa.
-- HONG KONG ECONOMIC JOURNAL -- The Bank of East Asia's announcement of a 14.4 percent rise in net profit was higher than market expectations.
-- TA KUNG PAO -- Chinese President Jiang Zemin said political stability in China provided a good investment atmosphere for foreign investors.
